title: From Style Replication to Style Exploration: Enabling Art Style Exploration with Analyze-Experiment-Resituate Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.14405v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Art style is a signature of professional digital artists that develops through repeated experimentation, reflection, and adaptation. While generative AI (GenAI) can reproduce styles with high fidelity, current tools provide limited support for exploring new stylistic directions and may encourage style replication over exploration. To address this gap, we propose Analyze-Experiment-Resituate (AER), a framework for AI-assisted style exploration derived from interviews with 10 professional digital artists. Rather than prioritizing visually appealing outputs alone, AER supports three core practices of style exploration, including interpreting references, trying out stylistic possibilities, and reflecting on how emerging styles may be received. translated_title: 从风格复制到风格探索：利用分析-实验-再情境化框架实现艺术风格探索
translated_abstract: 艺术风格是专业数字艺术家的标志性特征，它通过反复的实验、反思和调整而发展形成。虽然生成式人工智能（GenAI）能够以高保真度复制风格，但当前工具在支持探索新的风格方向方面能力有限，甚至可能鼓励风格复制而非探索。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了分析-实验-再情境化（AER）框架，这是一个基于对10位专业数字艺术家访谈得出的AI辅助风格探索框架。AER不仅优先考虑视觉上吸引人的输出，还支持风格探索的三个核心实践，包括解读参考、尝试风格可能性，以及反思新兴风格可能如何被接受。具体而言，AER使艺术家能够（1）将艺术作品分析为可解释的风格元素，（2）根据自身选择进行可控的实验，以及（3）将新兴风格再情境化。
tldr: 本文提出AER框架，通过分析、实验和再情境化三个步骤，帮助数字艺术家在AI辅助下进行风格探索而非单纯复制，从而拓展创作可能性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the AER framework, which supports digital artists in exploring art styles through analyze, experiment, and resituate practices, moving beyond mere style replication to foster creative exploration with AI assistance.
